Visa Debit Cards

Secure, smart and seamless payment.

Two NBCL Visa Debit Cards: Lokol for everyday chip-and-PIN purchases in PNG, and Classic for tapping, shopping online and travelling.

Compare cardsHow to apply

Lokol Visa Debit Card

Our most secure everyday card. Every purchase needs your PIN, so it's protected if lost.

  • No fee for your first card
  • Chip & PIN at ATMs and EFTPoS
  • Contactless and online purchases turned off for your security
  • Available to all transaction account holders, including Fairer Access
Lokol FAQs →

Classic Visa Debit Card

Use your money at millions of merchants and ATMs worldwide wherever Visa is accepted.

  • Contactless tap-and-pay, in PNG and overseas
  • Shop online with Visa Secure (3D Secure)
  • Real-time alerts by SMS, WhatsApp or email
  • Braille and an accessibility notch; made from recycled plastic
How to apply →

How to apply

Get your card in four steps.

1

Check eligibility

You need an NBCL transaction account that's active and in good standing.

2

Prepare documents

A valid photo ID (passport, driver's licence or NID) and proof of address, such as a utility bill or bank statement.

3

Apply

Complete the Visa Debit Card Application Form at any branch, or apply through NBCL Online Banking.

4

Receive & activate

Set your PIN on an NBCL EFTPoS device at any branch, then use your card in store, online or overseas.

Everyday spending

One card for the weekly shop.

Pay at supermarkets and stores across PNG, withdraw cash at ATMs, and see every purchase in the NBCL Mobile App.

  • Accepted wherever Visa is accepted
  • Real-time alerts by SMS, WhatsApp or email
  • Block your card instantly in the app

Tap to pay

Just tap and go.

Your Classic Visa Debit Card is contactless. Hold it near the EFTPoS terminal to pay in seconds. For larger amounts you will be asked for your PIN.

Contactless is turned off on the Lokol Visa Debit Card for extra security: insert your card and enter your PIN instead.

Shop online

Shop online with confidence.

Use your Classic Visa Debit Card on local and international websites. Visa Secure adds an extra check at checkout, and you'll get an alert for every purchase.

  • Visa Secure (3D Secure) on online purchases
  • Real-time alerts by SMS, WhatsApp or email
  • Online shopping is available on the Classic card only

Lost or stolen card?

Block it instantly.

Log in to the NBCL Mobile App or Online Banking to block your card straight away, or call our Customer Contact Centre.

Call (+675) 301 5480Log in to block

Questions

Card FAQs

Who can get a Classic Visa Debit Card?+

Anyone with an active NBCL Simpler Access or Smarter Access account.

Can I use my Classic card overseas and online?+

Yes. Use it anywhere Visa is accepted: online, in stores overseas, and at international ATMs.

How do I activate my card?+

Set your PIN and activate the card on an NBCL EFTPoS device at any branch or authorised location.

How do I use my Lokol card?+

Insert your card and enter your PIN at ATMs and EFTPoS terminals, and select Savings when asked. Your first Lokol card is a free swap; a replacement costs K10.

What if I forget my PIN or my card stops working?+

Visit any branch to reset your PIN, or call (+675) 301 5480. If your card is lost or stolen, block it straight away in the app or Online Banking.
